objective: Prepare a reviewable, idempotent Power Apps-to-Work Log acceptance boundary without making any Microsoft mutation.

projects.role: read-only project profile source during acceptance

clients.role: read-only client reference source where required

power_app.role: collect, retain and submit a human-confirmed capture only after the acceptance flow is independently approved and validated

acceptance_flow.role: validate, enforce idempotency, create exactly one canonical Work Log item, and return a durable receipt

architecture.trigger: Power Apps (V2) with submissionKey and payloadJson text inputs
sequence: validate exact environment, site, list, connection and flow identity
parse and validate the versioned payload against the repository contract
read project and client references without mutating their lists
look up Work Log by WorkCaptureSubmissionKey before any create
return the existing receipt when key and immutable payload agree
fail visibly when the key exists with different immutable facts or hash
create one Work Log item only when no matching key exists
read the created item back and return status, captureId, item ID and item URL
power_apps_role: generate and retain one submission UUID across retries
collect human-confirmed values and apply reviewed project defaults
disable duplicate taps while a request is active
show success only from a confirmed acceptance receipt
perform no direct Work Log create or update

idempotency.device_key: one UUID generated per capture and retained across retries
idempotency.same_key_same_payload: return the existing success receipt without a create
idempotency.same_key_different_payload: abort with an idempotency conflict and perform no mutation
idempotency.payload_comparison: compare WorkCapturePayloadHash only when produced by an approved native mechanism; otherwise compare every immutable human-fact field
idempotency.retry_rule: never retry an indeterminate create until a read-only lookup resolves whether the canonical item exists

this_repository_stage: documentation, configuration proposal and tests only
no SharePoint item, field, view, webhook, permission or schema mutation
no Power Automate flow creation, edit, save, enable, share or run
no Power Apps edit, connection, save, publish, share or run
future_owner_gated_stage: create and save only the exact reviewed UWC-AcceptCapture-v1 flow
use standard Power Apps and SharePoint connectors only
stop before app connection, flow enablement or any test run unless separately authorised

abort_conditions: branch, proposal hash, manifest hash or repository status differs from the approved checkpoint
environment, site, Work Log, Projects, Clients, app or flow identity differs
any connector is premium, custom, HTTP, Dataverse-backed or requests new consent
permissions, run-only sharing or connection ownership would broaden
the exact idempotency lookup and conflict paths cannot be implemented
a create result is ambiguous or read-back does not confirm the canonical item
the fresh owner window has not started or has expired
any schema, finance, rate, view, webhook, downstream list or production change is requested

rollback.repository_stage: revert only the proposal commit; no external rollback is applicable
rollback.future_flow_creation_stage: if validation fails before enablement, leave the flow disabled or remove only the newly created unconnected draft when the fresh owner GO explicitly authorises that cleanup
rollback.records: never delete or overwrite a potentially accepted Work Log record during recovery; resolve by read-only lookup and append-only correction
rollback.schema: do not delete the 29 activated optional fields; they remain dormant if the flow is not activated

validation: verify branch, HEAD, clean status and proposal hash
verify the frozen activation manifest SHA-256 and all bound resource identifiers
run focused Work Capture tests, full pytest on the supported POSIX runtime, Ruff and strict mypy
perform metadata-only identity and connector preflight under a separately approved read authority
run Flow Checker and save the disabled draft only during a fresh owner-approved creation window
under a later separate test-run approval, submit one synthetic non-customer capture and verify create, read-back, receipt and retry idempotency
verify the same key and same payload creates zero additional items
verify the same key and changed payload fails with zero mutation
verify repository status and all prohibited resources remain unchanged
next_gate: Owner review of this proposal and its final commit hash. A separate fresh, explicit, time-bounded owner GO is required before any Microsoft mutation.
